verdict:
SUBSTANTIVE LEAN IS KILL. The triage argues its own kill and argues it well: every refuting metric CONFIRMS the cohort narrative rather than refuting it. NAV/share $19.19 (9/30/25) -> $15.51 -> $10.56 -> $10.74 (6/30/26); cash distribution yield 19.0% -> 16.7% -> 16.3%; effective yield 13.8% -> 11.7% -> 11.1%; total investment income $117.8M -> $94.0M -> $87.0M; the monthly distribution was halved $0.40 -> $0.20 in January 2026. GAAP NII $0.51/q covers only ~0.85x of the $0.60/q distribution - and the $0.44 gap between GAAP NII and Core NII IS the write-down of future CLO-equity cash flows, i.e. the damage is arrived and marked, not pending. Management names ongoing spread compression as the primary structural headwind with ~60% of the portfolio carrying refi optionality through 2027, which is permanent income impairment rather than a mark. The one honest anomaly - price below NAV for the first time in years - is a ~7-9% cushion on a 99.6%-residual, model-marked, first-loss book. That is the market correctly de-rating the premium the ATM machine used to depend on, not dispersion the market missed.

BUT ESCALATE FIRES, AND NOT ONLY ON THE CLOCK. Three reasons:

(1) MANDATORY CLOCK TRIGGER. The triage's own PRINT PROXIMITY section places the July-31 monthly NAV estimate at ~2026-08-14 to 2026-08-17 - inside 5 trading days of 2026-08-15. It is cadence-derived, not company-confirmed (Oxford Lane publishes standalone mid-quarter NAV estimates on a ~10-17 day lag: 2/17/26 -> Jan-31 est, 3/10/26 -> Feb-28 est, 6/15/26 -> May-31 est). The rule fires on a due print regardless of whether a no-position verdict can be hurt by it.

(2) THIS IS NOT A NO-POSITION TICKET. The desk carries live exposure in the OXLC capital structure: OXLCZ is ledgered OWNABLE (Oxford Lane 5.00% senior note due 2027-01-31, callable now) with RESTING ORDERS at 24.50 and 24.65 flagged stale-below-market, and OXLCL is ledgered AVOID with a re-open alert at 23.50. A July-31 NAV print is a direct credit datum for the senior note that sits seven months from maturity above this book. The triage says so itself: 'the only ticket a court would genuinely change is the SENIOR instrument.' Adjudicating OXLC common as a standalone KILL while an imminent NAV print bears on live resting orders in the same issuer is the wrong unit of analysis. Escalate so the complex is ruled on together.

(3) AN OPEN ITEM THE TRIAGE COULD NOT CLOSE AND EXPLICITLY FLAGS AS COURT-NEEDED. The $150M repurchase program expired by its own terms on 2026-03-20 and nothing in the filing list through 8/14/26 confirms an extension either way. This is decision-relevant: a sub-NAV CEF with an active buyback is accretive and one without is not, and the sister vehicle ECC has already authorized one. It is also cheap to close (EDGAR / IR).

PRINT-DECISIVE RECONSTRUCTION - ACCEPTED AS METHOD, AND IT SHOULD BE GRADED. The triage resolves the imminent print BEFORE it lands using the sister vehicle that reports first: ECC estimated June-30 NAV $4.45-4.55 and July-31 NAV $4.33-4.43; midpoint -$0.12 of which $0.06 is the declared July distribution, leaving ~-1.3% ex-distribution asset move in July. Applied to OXLC ($10.74 less the $0.20 July distribution, less ~1.3%): July-31 NAV ~= $10.30-10.55, i.e. P/NAV ~0.92-0.94x at the then-price. Caveat correctly stated: ECC holds CLO debt alongside equity so it is a lower-beta proxy and a pure-equity book should print at the low end. Conclusion: the update is a non-event in either direction - it will not show the collapse bears need nor the discount bulls need. This is a genuinely good pre-print reconstruction and arming it as a graded pack is worth more than the verdict itself.

TAPE, VERIFIED AT ADJUDICATION (IBKR live). Last $9.64, prior close $9.73. The stock has ground UP 8 straight sessions into the NAV release: 8/05 9.11, 8/06 9.16, 8/07 9.20, 8/10 9.27, 8/11 9.32, 8/12 9.52, 8/13 9.73, 8/14 9.61/9.64 = +6.8% over the window. Two consequences: the discount the bull case rests on is compressing WITHOUT the print, and the dislocation doctrine is unsatisfied - there is no forced seller, the tape is bid.

DISPOSITION RECOMMENDED TO THE ESCALATION: AVOID on OXLC common, auto-resolving. If the July-31 NAV lands inside the reconstructed $10.30-10.55 band, the KILL stands with no further work and the escalation closes in one step. Rule separately on OXLCZ (the senior note) using the same print as a credit datum, and refresh its stale resting orders while you are there. || SESSION RULING: ESCALATION RULED: KILL applied now (substantive lean was well-argued: NAV 19.19->10.74, distribution halved, GAAP NII 0.85x coverage); the days-out NAV estimate GRADES it rather than gating it — pack armed on the $10.30-10.55 reconstruction band. INTERPLAY RECORDED: the NAV print is OXLCZ's (senior note, OWNABLE, resting orders) credit datum — OXLCZ record annotated, its orders stand on the note's own coverage math, not the common's.

court.record: batch 8/15; red None/blue None NO COURT - triage-routed straight from REFUTABILITY to ADJUDICATE on a court-worthiness score of 4/10. The single REFUTABILITY artifact (2026-08-14 08:54Z) IS the entire record.

reopen_gates: AUTO-RESOLVE: July-31 NAV estimate prints inside the reconstructed $10.30-10.55 band -> KILL stands, close the escalation, no further work. This is the intended one-step resolution.

DATA (must close before any re-court): was the $150M repurchase program - expired by its terms 2026-03-20 - extended? EDGAR/IR. A sub-NAV CEF with an active buyback is accretive; without one it is not. ECC has already authorized one.

EVENT (re-court trigger): a NEW buyback authorization announced while the stock trades below NAV, AND net share count falling. Absent both, the ATM/premium machine is simply broken and the discount is correct.

STRUCTURAL (re-court trigger): cash distribution yield on the CLO-equity book STOPS falling for two consecutive quarters (it has gone 19.0 -> 16.7 -> 16.3%) AND effective yield stabilises (13.8 -> 11.7 -> 11.1%). Until then the distribution is being funded out of principal repricing.

DIFFERENT TICKET (route, do not gate here): OXLCZ 5.00% senior note due 2027-01-31 - ledgered OWNABLE with stale resting orders at 24.50/24.65. Rule on it separately; a ~7.6% YTW on a seven-month senior claim is a carry decision, not a CLO-equity decision, and the July NAV print is its credit datum. Eagle Point Credit Management's SC 13D on ~20% of the 8.25% Series 2031 term preferred (5/8/26) is a further senior-instrument signal the common's KILL does not speak to.
